title: PixelKin - Hour Toll (sting)
_note: The Three Hours' threshold sting (walkthrough/07-the-three §3.6): a SINGLE deep bell-toll with a long shimmer tail — the hour an Hour is met. One low A toll (octave-doubled bell + a sub tri_bass swell under it), then a quiet high shimmer (E6/A6 bell motes, off the beat, fading) — the same A-minor world as battle-hours, so the sting hands straight into the bed. One-shot, ~3s + tail; render with --tail 3 for the shimmer to ring out. Original (VISION.md).

tracks.name: toll
tracks._note: The deep toll itself — one strike, octave-doubled, left to ring the whole bar.

tracks.name: sub
tracks._note: A soft sub swell under the strike — the toll felt through the floor.

tracks.name: shimmer
tracks._note: The shimmer tail: three quiet high motes drifting off the strike, ever softer — the sound of the air remembering the bell.
